sloka: किम् तु काल परीणामो द्रष्टव्यः साधु पश्यता ।धर्मः च अर्थः च कामः च कालक्रम समाहिताः ॥४-२५-८॥
transliteration: kim tu kāla parīṇāmo draṣṭavyaḥ sādhu paśyatā ।dharmaḥ ca arthaḥ ca kāmaḥ ca kālakrama samāhitāḥ ॥4-25-8॥

translations.english: 'However a wise man should visualise the turn of events in course of time with the right vision. Dharma, artha and kama are controlled by an order laid down by Time.
